description: Fiend's Knell retains both aggressive, faction-aligned, 30-second mate summons.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill_effects se JOIN effects e ON e.id = se.effect_id JOIN spawn_effects spawn ON spawn.id = e.actual_id WHERE se.skill_id = 23588 AND e.actual_type = 'SpawnEffect' AND spawn.owner_type_id = 5 AND spawn.sub_type IN (14165, 14166) AND spawn.life_time = 30 AND spawn.mate_state_id = 3 AND spawn.use_summoner_faction = 't' AND spawn.use_summoner_aggro_target = 't';
